tasks.description: Run an existing zero-resource diagnostic over already-created vehicle validation64 outputs to characterize learned-policy collapse and H35-switch/failure patterns after the all-shard pairwise summary showed learned_s0/s1 are constant H25 clones and learned_s2 is worse than its matched fixed-H25 comparator because of one catastrophic validation failure. The task must not open the validation bank/generator, must not run controllers/plants/solvers, must not train/refit, and must not access sealed/final tests. The purpose is to decide whether the next recoverable nonzero experiment should keep debugging the current latency-tree selector or pivot to true variable-dimension controller/value/scenario work once backup is restored.
tasks.method: Zero-resource learned-policy collapse/H35-pattern diagnostic using existing validation64 output artifacts only; no validation bank source opening; no solver/plant/controller execution; no training/refit; no new validation episodes; no sealed/final test; summarize constant-H25 collapse for learned_s0/s1, learned_s2 H35 usage/failure concentration and implications for next nonzero development experiment.

config_constraints.evidence_motivation: All-shard summary: learned_s0 and learned_s1 exactly match fixed H25 physically with zero switches; learned_s2 has 64 episodes, 63 successes, one failure, 178 switches, 409 H35 steps, physical mean 628.572 versus matched fixed H25 18.918, decision mean ratio 1.007. Case43 learned_s2 failed with 149 H25 and 1 H35 step while fixed H25 and fixed H35 comparators succeeded.
config_constraints.allowed_inputs: already-created validation64 shard output artifacts and the just-created all-shard summary outputs; no validation bank/generator source file may be opened by this task
